apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it

Coming from an old nightly? It is now a separate app (ARMSX2 Nightly) that installs
beside the stable app. The old nightly cannot install a stable over itself, because
Android refuses that version downgrade, so to return to stable: back up your saves
and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install a stable APK.

## What's new
- Include <cstring> where our code calls it
- GS: fuse the UV-addressed packed triple for triangle strips
- GS: SetTag names the UV-addressed packed triple
- tests: pin that a wider GS->GS move into a small target stays on the GPU
- GS/TC: let a move grow its destination target's width, not only its height
- GS: don't log hardware GS->GS moves in the transfer list
- Counters/ADPF: report one work period per frame across the split frame limiter
- microVU/arm64: ignore the MAC flag instance under the flag hack, not the status one
- GS/Vulkan: make the first reader of each pass change the loop-enable value
- gsrunner: -readback-kick-passes, the readback-frame submit spacing for an A/B
- GS: drop the readback-source hint the Vulkan kick no longer reads
- GS/Vulkan: let the readback-frame kick fire where a draw switches target
- Android: ask AI agents to leave the anti-resale notice in place
- Audio/Oboe: read at the device's burst size instead of 2048 frames
- GS/Vulkan: present the image when acquire returns SUBOPTIMAL
- Audio/Oboe: open the stream with the expansion mode's channel count
- Debugger: Fix unsaved debugger breakpoints not being removed when loaded from settings.
- GS/HW: convert lines to pixel runs in one walk, without per-pixel divides
- GS: let a line walk's caller fix the major axis at compile time
- tests: pin GSLineRuns::Convert byte for byte against the original
- GS/HW: move the line pixel-run conversion into GSLineRuns
- gsrunner: switches to size the Vulkan vertex ring for an A/B
- GS/Vulkan: grow the vertex ring instead of draining the GPU
- GS: decide how far a full stream ring grows instead of waiting
- Qt: Update Base Translation.
- GS:HW: Denormalize RT color when shuffling while blending.
- GHActions: Disable LTO on debug builds
- GHActions: Generate debug caches in release builds
- GHActions: Separate debug from release caches
- GHActions: Clean old stuff out of ccache
- GS/Shaders: Fix up types mismatch.
- GS/GL: Drop requirement for GL_ARB_gpu_shader5.
- GS:Vk: Use feedback loop layout when fbfetch is disabled
- GS/DX11: Fix null texture related crashes when device creation fails.
- GS: Switch CAS from compute shader type to pixel shader type.
- Qt: Update Base Translation.
- GS:HW: Remove integer bitcast version of GSVector4::cxpr().
- Qt: Add Controller Tester button
- Qt: Use QHeaderView::Stretch for the game list title columns
- GS:MTL: Mention OCLP in the no-metal-devices error
- GS:MTL: Don't crash if no Metal device
